notes: MANUALLY CREATED RECORD (M-prefix: not from the GEDCOM; parser re-runs never touch it). Ellen M Larkin's mother, identified 2026-07-03 by the tree owner's GRO index lookup: maiden name McALONE. Forename unknown. Irish surname, fitting Whitehaven's Irish Catholic community.

SAMUEL CONFIRMED HERS (2026-07-03, owner's GRO lookup): 'LARKIN, SAMUEL, 1903 J Quarter, WHITEHAVEN 10B/733, Mother's Maiden Surname: MCALONE' — Ellen and Samuel (M0002) are full siblings, and she was Thomas's recorded wife from at least 1903 through Ellen's 1907 registration. REMAINING OPEN: her forename; whether she is the 'Mary Ellen Larkin, 42' who died Mar Q 1906 Whitehaven (10b/429) — now UNLIKELY as Ellen's Nov 1906 birth follows it, unless that death was another family's; her fate by 1921 (Ellen emigrated alone); the marriage (not registered in Cumberland 1880-1911 — likely Ireland, Scotland, or pre-1892 Maine).
